slides.title: Anthropic is giving startups a *free year of Claude*
slides.subtitle: Plus $1,000 in API credits. How to apply, step by step.

slides.label: What you get
slides.title: in Claude API credits, once
slides.body: Plus a free year of Claude Team for up to *five Premium seats*, if your company is new to Team.

slides.label: 01 · Check you qualify
slides.title: Founded in 5 years, or funded in 2
slides.body: Startups founded in the last five years, or funded in the last two, can apply. *No VC needed*: bootstrapped and pre-seed teams are welcome.

slides.label: 02 · Set up the basics
slides.title: Console account, matching email
slides.body: You need a Claude Console account, a company email that matches your website's domain, and a short description of what you're building.

slides.label: 03 · Apply
slides.title: Write it like a brief
slides.body: Apply on the Claude Startups page. Anthropic says it reviews every application. Say who it's for, what it does, and *why Claude*. Two plain sentences.

slides.label: 04 · Claim Team
slides.title: Watch for the approval email
slides.body: It links to the Claude Startups page in Claude Console. Sign in there to claim Team. Credits work on the *first-party Claude API*, not Bedrock or Vertex.

slides.label: 05 · Stack the extras
slides.title: Partner offers, up to $45K
slides.body: The Claude Startup Stack lists offers like ElevenLabs, Gamma and Granola. They come from *independent companies*, on their own terms, and may not combine.

slides.label: The catch
slides.title: Read the fine print
slides.body: Team is free only if you're *new to Team*. The "up to $7,000" headline assumes five seats at $100 a month plus credits. Fewer seats, less value.
